content: सूचिः, -ची {%f.%} [सूच्-इन् वा ङीप्] .²1 Piercing, perforating. .²2 A needle; निमेषादपि कौन्तेय यस्यायुरपचीयते . सूच्येबाञ्जनचूर्णस्य किमिति प्रतिपालयेत् .. <ls>Mb. 3. 35. 3</ls>. .²3 Sharp point or pointed blade (as of Kuśa grass); अभिनवकुशसूच्या परिक्षतं मे चरणम् <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; so मुखे कुशसूचिविद्धे <ls>Ś. 4. 13</ls>. .²4 The sharp point or tip of anything; कः करं प्रसारयेत् पन्नगरत्नसूचये <ls>Ku. 5. 43</ls>. .²5 The point of a bud. .²6 A kind of military array, a sharp column or file; दण्डव्यहेन तन्मार्गं यायात् तु शकटेन वा . वराहमकराभ्यां वा सूच्या वा गरुडेन वा <ls>Ms. 7. 187</ls>. .²7 A triangle formed by the sides of a trapezium produced till they meet. .²8 A cone, pyramid. .²9 Indication by gesture, communicating by signs, gesticulation. .²10 A particular mode of dancing. .²11 Dramatic action. .²12 An index, a table of contents. .²13 A list, catalogue. .²14 The earthʼs disc in computing eclipses (in <ab>astr.</ab>). .²15 A rail or balustrade. .²16 A small door-bolt. .²17 A kind of coitus.
सूचिः {%m.%} .²1 The son of निषाद and a वैश्या. .²2 A maker of winnowing baskets <ab>&c.</ab>
